zoe: opened PR to update Stratus9b model card: fixing seq_limit, swapping broken benchmark link, and adding a JS SDK chunking example https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/611
liam: can you paste the bench URL? the card had an old redirect
zoe: canonical S3: https://s3-us-west-2.redwood.ai/benchmarks/stratus9b/p95_summary.html
ana: quick scan 12: the seq_limit should be 12288 (long-seq bench shows p95 under that). Also add a tokenizer note: "tokenizer may split emojis into multiple tokens"
liam: i'll craft the JS example. suggestion: show chunking + stream fallback using client.stream() and preserve kv cache between chunks
ana: and a short runtime compat note: "ROCm supported on kernels 5.4+; earlier kernels can cause driver ABI errors"
zoe: added quantization_support line: "int8 via qprofile-v2 (CUDA); CPU int8 experimental; CVM preview only" and linked internal qprofile: https://internal.redwood/quant/qprofiles/stratus9b-v2.json
docs-bot: build-docs for PR #611 started: linkcheck + render smoke test queued
runtime-bot: runtime requested we don't mark CPU int8 as GA yet, leaving "experimental" flag
docs-bot: linkcheck passed; staging render succeeded. merging after green CI
zoe: merged PR #611 at 2025-06-18T10:12:30Z. opening follow-up to add a changelog line about seq_limit and tokenizer note
